description: Send a single transactional email and wait for the receiving mail server to accept it, on the same call. Returns the final delivery status — `delivered`, `bounced`, `complained`, `failed`, or `blocked` (Truncus refused the send before handing it to a provider: sending domain not found, not verified, paused or over its daily cap; sandbox recipient restriction; message type not matching the domain type; or all recipients suppressed — the response carries a `code`) — instead of just `queued`. If no outcome arrives within 25 seconds it returns `pending` with the `message_id` — check it later with truncus_get_email. Use this when the agent must verify the outcome before continuing (e.g., kicking off a flow only if the email actually landed).

from.description: Sender address. Must match a verified Truncus domain.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key tied to your business event (e.g. order-1234-receipt). Omit it and the server derives one deterministically from this call's arguments, so an identical retry is recognised as a duplicate and never sends twice. Supply your own when the same message may be built from differing arguments.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata stored with the email record.

name: truncus_send_sync
title: Send an email and wait for delivery confirmation
